Trainable filters include raw low-rank factors and exclude base; persisted state remains existing factors/optimizer/RNG/step schema, not new identity schema.
HF converter stays bound to actual original initialization source during adapter resume, even with source vocabulary in checkpoint metadata; mismatched source vocabulary is rejected.
Native export paths and upload options are validated before initialization; NoAdaptor and Lora hooks retain their distinct hf_save_path versus peft/merged contracts.
Existing named adapter branches and source caller behavior remain intact; no changes to train_dpo/model_init in this extraction.

Independent local Torch test reads actual PEFT factor files and applies scaled B@A on original local HF base, then also reads merged HF weights; no actual PeftModel availability is implied.
Literal TPU markers/default test safety policy and numerical tolerances retained; no new live-cluster or storage operations introduced.
